items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: The only piano player that I knew around Donaldsonville was Monnie Jones and Claiborne William Darden.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Yeah, I know. I ain't gonna tell nobody. Was that it? Do you remember? Yeah, yeah, yeah. That was a good number. Yeah. There were a lot of good tunes. Did you ever know a piano player from Donaldsonville called Fishing Braid? Nope. His right name was Richard Barrett. I think...

I heard of Tony Cal or something like that. Cy Cal. You ever heard of Cy Cal or something? Tell me he's holding me. He got... Mm-mm. The only piano player that I knew around Donaldsonville was Monnie Jones and Claiborne William Darden. We call her Bella. Bella. Mm-hmm. I just wanted because...

What you call that name for me again? Fishing Braid they called him. But... His name was Richard Barrett. He must have been older than Monnie, you see. Because I think he helped Monnie if I remember it right. See, I looked at Monnie's story and I thought maybe you'd know some of the same people and could straighten us out on them.
